newsitems.title: PUBG x G-DRAGON Web Event
newsitems.author: TecK
newsitems.contents: [p align="start"]Enter the PUBG x G-DRAGON Lucky Draw for a chance to win limited-edition goods! Even if you’re not a PUBG player, anyone can enter with just an email address. Verifying your PUBG account will increase your chances of winning! What's more, you can also download collaboration images from the PUBG x G-DRAGON Gallery! [/p][p][/p][h3]How to Enter[/h3][p]Event Page: [/p][p][url="https://pubg.com/events/g-dragonxpubg"]https://pubg.com/events/g-dragonxpubg[/url][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Verify your email address or log in with your KRAFTON ID after following the link to enter the lucky draw.[/p][list][*][p]Entering the page via the lobby banner will log you in automatically.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Users who join via email not linked to a PUBG account will receive 1 entry ticket.[/p][/*][*][p]Users who have linked their PUBG accounts with KRAFTON ID, or participate directly with a PUBG account, can receive up to 2 entry tickets.[/p][/*][*][p]The winners will be announced after the lucky draw ends. Don’t forget to check the results via the event page or the email you used to enter![/p][/*][*][p]Check out the event page to access a detailed compilation of all necessary information and guidelines for each event.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Rewards[/h3][list][*][p]PUBG x G-DRAGON Ultimate Set with Autographed Album (1 winner)[/p][/*][*][p]PUBG x G-DRAGON Special Set (10 winners)[/p][/*][*][p]G-DRAGON PEACEMINUSONE SET (30 winners)[/p][/*][*][p]G-DRAGON - Pan (100 winners)[/p][/*][*][p]500 G-Coin (7 Days) (500 winners)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Event Schedule (UTC)[/h3][list][*][p]Participation Period[/p][list][*][p]PC/Console: September 10, 07:00 - September 23, 07:00[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Winners Announcement[/p][list][*][p]September 30, 07:00[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Shipping Information Submission[/p][list][*][p]September 30, 07:00 - October 27, 07:00[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reward Distribution[/p][list][*][p]If you win in-game item rewards, a redeem code will be sent to the email address used for entry.[/p][list][*][p]On the Results popup, you can select your preferred platform to receive your redeem code.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Physical rewards will be sent sequentially starting from October 27.[/p][list][*][p]We will send a separate notification email to the address you used for entry.[b] Please check your email inbox carefully.[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
